metadata.purpose: Deterministic evaluation benchmark for requirement-to-evidence matching, importance tagging, and skill cluster assignment.

cases.requirement: Experience developing backend applications in Python.
cases.evidence: Developed backend applications in Python for financial reporting.
cases.rationale: Resume evidence directly demonstrates python backend development.

cases.requirement: Proficient with PostgreSQL database administration and query optimization.
cases.evidence: Managed PostgreSQL databases including index tuning and query optimization.
cases.rationale: Direct match on PostgreSQL administration and query tuning.

cases.requirement: Build dynamic single-page web applications using React.
cases.evidence: Built dynamic single-page web applications using React and Redux.
cases.rationale: Direct demonstration of React single-page application development.

cases.requirement: Design and implement REST APIs for client applications.
cases.evidence: Designed and implemented REST APIs serving millions of mobile clients.
cases.rationale: Direct match on REST API design and implementation.

cases.requirement: Containerize microservices using Docker.
cases.evidence: Containerized microservices using Docker for multi-environment deployments.
cases.rationale: Direct match on microservice containerization with Docker.

cases.requirement: Develop backend web services using Python.
cases.evidence: Built server-side APIs in Python using modern asynchronous frameworks.
cases.rationale: Paraphrase: server-side APIs in Python is equivalent to backend web services in Python.

cases.requirement: Analyze datasets statistically to identify business trends.
cases.evidence: Conducted rigorous statistical analysis on customer data to uncover purchasing patterns.
cases.rationale: Paraphrase: statistical analysis on customer data corresponds to analyzing datasets statistically.

cases.requirement: Establish CI/CD deployment pipelines for automated releases.
cases.evidence: Configured continuous integration and continuous delivery workflows using GitHub Actions.
cases.rationale: Paraphrase: CI/CD deployment pipelines maps directly to continuous integration and delivery workflows.

cases.requirement: Architect low-latency distributed storage systems.
cases.evidence: Designed high-throughput distributed caching and storage clusters with sub-10ms response times.
cases.rationale: Paraphrase: high-throughput distributed caching/storage with sub-10ms latency demonstrates low-latency distributed storage.

cases.requirement: Experience with production Kubernetes cluster orchestration and management.
cases.evidence: Packaged and ran containerized backend microservices using Docker.
cases.rationale: Partial: Docker demonstrates containerization understanding, but not Kubernetes cluster orchestration.

cases.requirement: Deploy and manage infrastructure on Amazon Web Services (AWS).
cases.evidence: Deployed enterprise web applications on Microsoft Azure using App Services and ARM templates.
cases.rationale: Partial: Azure demonstrates cloud infrastructure management, but not the requested AWS cloud platform.

cases.requirement: Train and deploy deep learning neural network models in production.
cases.evidence: Built linear regression and decision tree models using Scikit-Learn.
cases.rationale: Partial: Classical ML algorithms demonstrate predictive modeling knowledge, but not deep neural network training.

cases.requirement: Build responsive front-end user interfaces using React.
cases.evidence: Developed interactive web pages using vanilla JavaScript and DOM manipulation.
cases.rationale: Partial: JavaScript demonstrates core web fundamentals, but does not prove React framework proficiency.

cases.requirement: Write complex relational SQL queries and database migrations.
cases.evidence: Stored and queried semi-structured document collections using MongoDB.
cases.rationale: Partial: NoSQL document storage demonstrates database awareness, but does not demonstrate relational SQL and schema migrations.

cases.requirement: Experience managing Kubernetes clusters in production environments.
cases.evidence: Designed responsive website UI layouts and marketing graphics in Figma.
cases.rationale: Weak: UI graphic design provides no meaningful support for Kubernetes cluster management.

cases.requirement: Administer and optimize PostgreSQL relational database instances.
cases.evidence: Wrote marketing copy and customer newsletter articles for product launches.
cases.rationale: Weak: Copywriting is completely unrelated to relational database administration.

cases.requirement: Train transformer-based NLP models for text classification.
cases.evidence: Organized annual technology conferences and coordinated logistics for 500 attendees.
cases.rationale: Weak: Event logistics provides no support for training NLP transformer models.

cases.requirement: Manage cloud networking, VPC peering, and security groups in AWS.
cases.evidence: Edited video podcasts and produced audio content for social media.
cases.rationale: Weak: Video and audio production is irrelevant to cloud network engineering.

cases.requirement: Configure automated end-to-end testing suites using Playwright or Cypress.
cases.evidence: Maintained clean office workspace and managed daily mail deliveries.
cases.rationale: Weak: The resume provides no technical evidence supporting automated end-to-end testing.

cases.requirement: Proficiency in writing high-performance C++ systems software.
cases.evidence: Conducted sales calls and updated CRM customer records.
cases.rationale: Weak: Administrative CRM tracking contains no evidence of C++ systems programming.

cases.requirement: Fine-tune large language models for domain-specific retrieval tasks.
cases.evidence: Prepared quarterly balance sheets and reconciled accounting ledgers.
cases.rationale: Weak: Accounting spreadsheets provide no evidence of LLM fine-tuning.

cases.requirement: Build Python REST APIs and deploy containerized services using Kubernetes.
cases.evidence: Built Python REST APIs using FastAPI and deployed services on Kubernetes clusters.
cases.rationale: Strong: The evidence supports both the backend Python API and Kubernetes deployment capabilities.

cases.requirement: Build Python REST APIs and deploy containerized services using Kubernetes.
cases.evidence: Created Python REST APIs with Django for internal customer administration.
cases.rationale: Partial: The evidence supports the backend Python API portion but lacks the Kubernetes deployment capability.

cases.requirement: Build Python REST APIs and deploy containerized services using Kubernetes.
cases.evidence: Administered multi-region Kubernetes clusters and container workloads in AWS.
cases.rationale: Partial: The evidence supports the Kubernetes deployment portion but does not demonstrate Python REST API development.

cases.requirement: Build Python REST APIs and deploy containerized services using Kubernetes.
cases.evidence: Managed social media marketing campaigns and created email newsletters.
cases.rationale: Weak: Marketing evidence supports neither Python backend APIs nor Kubernetes deployment.

cases.requirement: Must have 3+ years of experience with Python programming.
cases.evidence: Developed software using Python for over 4 years across backend services.
cases.rationale: Strong: Directly supports required Python experience requirement.

cases.requirement: Nice to have: experience with GraphQL API endpoints.
cases.evidence: Designed and implemented GraphQL schemas and resolvers in Apollo Server.
cases.rationale: Strong: Demonstrates preferred GraphQL capability without changing semantic matching strength.

cases.requirement: Experience with Docker containerization is a plus.
cases.evidence: Created Dockerfiles and managed local development containers.
cases.rationale: Strong: Demonstrates preferred Docker containerization capability.

cases.requirement: Write clean, modular code utilizing modern object-oriented programming patterns.
cases.evidence: Applied object-oriented principles, design patterns, and clean code conventions in daily development.
cases.rationale: Boundary (Programming vs Backend): Focuses strictly on core programming language hygiene and code patterns.

cases.requirement: Provision infrastructure using Terraform and maintain CI/CD pipelines.
cases.evidence: Authored Terraform infrastructure-as-code modules and configured automated CI/CD runners.
cases.rationale: Boundary (Backend vs Cloud & DevOps): Focuses on infrastructure provisioning and delivery automation.

cases.requirement: Perform statistical hypothesis testing, A/B experiment evaluation, and exploratory data analysis.
cases.evidence: Executed A/B test analysis, two-tailed hypothesis tests, and exploratory analysis on user cohorts.
cases.rationale: Boundary (Data Science vs Machine Learning): Emphasizes classical statistics and experimentation.

cases.requirement: Train neural machine translation and semantic text embedding models.
cases.evidence: Trained sequence-to-sequence translation and dense text embedding models using PyTorch.
cases.rationale: Boundary (Machine Learning vs AI/NLP): Centers on natural language processing representations.

cases.requirement: Implement responsive web UI components with CSS Flexbox and accessible HTML5 semantics.
cases.evidence: Coded accessible HTML5 interfaces and responsive layouts with modern CSS Flexbox and Grid.
cases.rationale: Boundary (Frontend vs Programming): Focuses strictly on UI styling and client markup.

cases.requirement: Design distributed architecture capable of handling horizontal failover and data partitioning.
cases.evidence: Architected distributed multi-node system utilizing consistent hashing and automated failover.
cases.rationale: Boundary (System Design vs Backend): Deals with high-level distributed systems architecture.

cases.requirement: Design relational database schemas and optimize B-tree indexes for high-volume transactions.
cases.evidence: Designed relational schemas and tuned B-tree indexes to handle 10k transactions per second.
cases.rationale: Boundary (Databases vs Backend): Focuses specifically on schema modeling and database indexing.
